lines.zh: 它发出嘶嘶声，寻找猎物。
它的复眼转动寻找猎物。
lines.en: Its compound eyes search for prey.

lines.zh: 多目鬼虫爬向你的方向。
我沿着梦魇的石壁爬行。
lines.en: I crawl along the nightmare's stone.

lines.zh: 多目鬼虫发出低沉的嘶嘶声。

lines.en: A hundred eyes open at once.
My segments drag a trail on the ground.

lines.zh: 它的复眼盯着一个方向。
lines.en: Its compound eyes focus on a point.
It rests quietly in the shadows.

lines.zh: 它的复眼注视着空旷之地。
lines.en: Its compound eyes stare into the void.

lines.zh: 多目鬼虫静静地等待猎物。
lines.en: The Vermenous waits quietly for prey.

lines.zh: 它的复眼始终盯着一个目标。
lines.en: Its compound eyes are fixed on a target.

lines.zh: 多目鬼虫静静地栖息着。

lines.en: Its compound eyes widen to focus on you.

lines.zh: 多目鬼虫盯着你一动不动。
lines.en: The Vermenous fixes you in its gaze.
Its compound eyes blink, locking on.
The Vermenous tightens its gaze on you.

lines.zh: 它复眼盯着你，准备攻击。
lines.en: Its compound eyes stare, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 多目鬼虫的复眼盯紧你。
lines.en: The Vermenous's compound eyes tighten on you.

lines.zh: 它复眼盯着你，准备出击。
lines.en: Its compound eyes focus, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 多目鬼虫盯着你，准备捕捉。
lines.en: The Vermenous eyes you, ready to capture.

lines.zh: 它复眼锁定目标，准备攻击。
lines.en: Its compound eyes lock on, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 我的复眼裂了两只，看不清。
lines.en: Two of my cluster eyes split — I can't see.
Look straight at my eyes and you'll reel.

lines.zh: 你散发的光芒吸引着我...
lines.en: The light you emit attracts me...

lines.zh: 我的眼睛...看不清你的真面目...
lines.en: My eyes... can't discern your true form...

lines.zh: 为什么...你看起来那么美味?
lines.en: Why... do you look so delicious?
Your light... makes me want to approach...

lines.zh: 你在发光...这是我的弱点...
你的存在...让我无法抗拒...
你身上的光芒...吸引着我...
lines.en: The light on you... attracts me...
My触角碰到了你... My触角碰到了你...
My eyes... are hurting from the collision...
My speed... is slowed by you...
My触须... is scattered by you...
The collision... makes me more aggressive...
My同类... is also seeking you...

lines.zh: 我在这里...等待我的同类...
lines.en: I'm here... waiting for my同类...

lines.zh: 我的眼睛太多，看你看得发毛。
lines.en: I've too many eyes, and you make them crawl.

lines.zh: 干净的珍珠落进我爪里。
lines.en: A clean pearl drops into my claws.
Look at me, and you'll die.

lines.zh: 我的十只眼都看见你了。
lines.en: All ten of my eyes have found you.
All three eyes fix on you.
Pearls, my prey — 多目鬼虫, target acquire

lines.zh: 黑水里每道目光都是我。
lines.en: Every gaze in the black water is mine.
I see every outline of you.

lines.zh: 我的每一只眼都跟着你转。
lines.en: Every eye I have turns to follow you.
Prey on the nightmare's second floor.

lines.zh: 你的影子在动，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shadow moved. I saw it.
I am not hunting you for pearls.

lines.zh: 一百只眼睛只需要一个目标。
lines.en: A hundred eyes need only one target.
Look at me, and you'll regret it.
The pearl stays. You do not.

lines.zh: 你从哪边来我都看得见。
lines.en: I see you from whichever side you come.
My gaze has wound around you.

lines.zh: 你举起盾也挡不住目光。
lines.en: A shield will not block a stare.
My fangs open and close a little.

lines.zh: 第二层的空气告诉我你在哪。
lines.en: The air of the second floor tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 你数不清我到底有几只眼。
lines.en: You cannot count how many eyes I have.
I stare at your feet, not your face.
One glance at me weakens your knees.
The pearl stays here, and so do you.
Look at me, you'll regret it!
Every eye I have is on you!
My fangs sink into your arm!
A hundred eyes turn on you at once!

lines.zh: 我的体液烧着你的皮肤！

lines.en: My tendrils tighten around your throat!
My stare has frozen you in place!
This bite lands on your collarbone!
My legs pin down your chest!
The taste of blood brightens my eyes!
I have seen every part of you!
Nightmare layer two, and every eye opens.
Second layer of the nightmare world!
You came at the wrong time!
I'm the guardian of the nightmare!

lines.zh: 一百只眼睛在黑暗里睁开。
lines.en: A hundred eyes open in the dark.

lines.zh: 我从第二层的缝隙里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack on the second floor.

lines.zh: 复眼被火燎得看不清了！
lines.en: The fire scorched my compound eyes blind!

lines.zh: 梦魇的珍珠掉进水里了。
lines.en: My nightmare pearl sank in the water.

lines.zh: 梦魇第二层的地面塌了。
lines.en: The floor of nightmare two caved in.
An arrow pierces one of my eye stalks.

lines.zh: 魔法刺痛了我所有的眼。
lines.en: The spell stings every one of my eyes.

lines.zh: 我身上的眼睛一齐眨了一下。
lines.en: Every eye on my body blinks at once.
